latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Easily turn your photos into shareable video slideshows with cloud rendering and simple prompts.

- Upload photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP; up to 200MB) and create 1080p MP4 video slideshows in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic first-time setup with free credits—no installation required.
- Supports easy commands for export, uploading, editing, checking credits, and viewing project status.
- Cloud GPU processing ensures fast exports and supports up to 20 photos per project for optimal speed.
- Error handling for common issues like file type, size, rate limits, and authentication.
- Step-by-step guidance for beginners, including suggested prompts and quick workflow tips.
